questions.help:
Safe driving    
 
7 Driving on ice
When there is the presence of ice on the road, drivers should adopt the same precaution as travelling on snow. This means that, similar to snow, there is a risk of sliding and skidding. Always operate the hand controls and foot controls smoothly.
Turn the steering wheel, gently as it is particularly sensitive and the steering will feel very light when driving on ice. This is because there is reduced grip (adhesion) between the tyres and icy road surface. Smoothly and progressively, operate the clutch, accelerator and brake. 
It is better to raise the foot slowly off the accelerator in a bid to lose speed. Try to avoid using the brakes, and always brake gently where necessary, so as not to lose control of the car.
 
(Página 230 del manual 'Learning to drive')

16.1 Factors affecting alcohol limits
The time that has elapsed since the alcohol was consumed. It is possible to detect alcohol 5 minutes after consuming it. Over time this increases and a maximum is reached (called peak blood alcohol content) about an hour later. (Note: This may vary between 30 and 90 minutes) The level starts to fall below this maximum level very slowly with the effects lasting for    several hours and it will not completely disappear for a further period of time.
The type of drink and method of ingestion. Alcohol is absorbed more quickly in distilled beverages (such as whiskey or gin) than through fermented drinks (such as beer or wine). Prohibits access to mopeds. Also prohibits entry to vehicles for persons with reduced mobility.
(Página 125 del manual 'Learning to drive')

In a car, is it compulsory to have a high-visibility reflective vest?
questions.help:
Journeys and defensive and efficient driving           
         
1 Preparation for the trip      
1.3 Accessories, spare parts and tools      
Cars
- The V-16 light-emitting hazard warning device.
- A certified, high-visibility reflective vest inside the interior of the vehicle. It must be visible from at least 150 metres away. If the vehicle is an escort vehicle, protecting and accompanying others, vests must be worn by the driver and each member of the crew.
- A full-size spare or a temporary tyre, with the tools needed to change tyres, or an alternative system to changing them that offers sufficient guarantees for the mobility of the vehicle. In these cases, the vehicles will be driven in observance of the limitations of each alternative.
(Página 270 del manual 'Learning to drive')
